# 01: Ask before editing skill-generated files

**What to build:** Any agent edit to a file generated by the mattpocock skills prompts the human first, even in auto mode. Add `ask` permission rules to the shared Claude Code settings for the root `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/`, the git workflow doc, `.agents/`, `.claude/skills/` and `skills-lock.json`. Add a section below the `## Agent skills` block in the root `AGENTS.md` saying these files are skill-generated, that an agent must ask the human before changing them, and must never work around the prompt via the shell. No other change.

**Blocked by:** None (can start immediately)

**Status:** ready-for-agent

- [ ] The shared settings have `ask` rules covering exactly the files above; existing settings are kept
- [ ] An `Edit` to `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` prompts in auto mode (checked manually; note the result in `## Comments`)
- [ ] The new `AGENTS.md` section sits below the `## Agent skills` block, whose text is unchanged
- [ ] The section names the known gaps (`bypassPermissions`, shell writes)
- [ ] Root `AGENTS.md` stays at or under about 40 lines
- [ ] No package change; `pnpm lint` passes
